text: Thanks so much for coming round last weekend to help me set up my new laptop – I honestly couldn’t have done it without you!

It’s working perfectly now. I’ve already got into the habit of backing up my photos every Sunday, just like you showed me, and the video calls with my parents are so much clearer than they used to be on my old phone.

I’ve also started the online photography course I told you about. There are two lessons a week, and I have to upload a few pictures after each one, so the new laptop has made a huge difference. My teacher even said last week that my editing is getting better!

To say thank you properly, I’d love to take you out for dinner. There’s a new Italian place near the station that everyone’s talking about. Would you be free next Friday or Saturday evening? I’ll book a table for whichever day suits you.
Let me know soon, and thanks again for all your help.

note.en: Refers back to what the friend taught.
note.ru: Отсылает к тому, чему научил друг.

note.kk: Салыстыру: қалай болды және қалай болды.
note.ru: Сравнение: как было и как стало.

note.en: Adds a second topic: the course.
A consequence: why the laptop matters so much.
Introduces the purpose of the invitation.
Leaves the choice to the friend.

strengths.en: Not just “thanks” but what now works thanks to the friend.
strengths.kk: Жай «thanks» емес, достың арқасында не шығатыны айтылған.
strengths.ru: Не просто «thanks», а что именно теперь получается благодаря другу.

strengths.en: Contractions, “honestly” and exclamations, as in a real letter to a friend.
strengths.kk: Қысқартулар, «honestly», лепті сөйлемдер — досқа жазылған нағыз хаттағыдай.
strengths.ru: Сокращения, «honestly», восклицания — как в настоящем письме другу.
strengths.example: I honestly couldn’t have done it without you!

strengths.en: A place, two possible days and a promise to book a table.
strengths.kk: Орны, күннің екі нұсқасы және үстел брондау уәдесі.
strengths.ru: Место, два варианта дня и обещание забронировать стол.
strengths.example: Would you be free next Friday or Saturday evening?

strengths.en: Present perfect, past simple, present simple and would: an informal tone does not stop accurate grammar.
strengths.kk: present perfect, past simple, present simple, would — бейресми үн дәл грамматикаға кедергі емес.
strengths.ru: present perfect, past simple, present simple, would — информальный тон не мешает точной грамматике.
strengths.example: I’ve already got into the habit of backing up my photos

note.en: A friend, by first name: informal.
Thanks straight away, warmly and sincerely.
note.kk: Алғыс бірден, эмоциямен әрі шын көңілден.

note.en: Bullet 1 developed: what has changed thanks to the friend’s help.
note.kk: 1-тармақ дамытылған: достың көмегінің арқасында не өзгерді.
note.ru: Пункт 1 развит: что изменилось благодаря помощи друга.

note.en: Bullet 2: what the computer is for — a photography course, with details.
note.kk: 2-тармақ — компьютер не үшін: фотография курсы, деректерімен.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — для чего компьютер: курс фотографии, с деталями.

note.en: Bullet 3: an invitation with a place and possible dates.
note.kk: 3-тармақ — орны мен күн нұсқалары бар шақыру.
note.ru: Пункт 3 — приглашение с местом и вариантами дат.

note.en: A short request for a reply and thanks again.
note.kk: Жауап беруді сұрайтын қысқа өтініш және тағы да алғыс.
note.ru: Короткая просьба ответить и ещё раз спасибо.

note.en: “Best wishes” is a standard friendly sign-off.
